summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Goldman Sachs Enhanced U.S. Equity ETF (GUSE) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the S&P 500 index. The fund is an actively managed ETF. The fund invests in a diverse portfolio of US equities considered to be high quality companies poised for long-term growth GUSE was launched on Nov 17, 2025 and is issued by Goldman Sachs.

holdings.infoBox: GUSE is an equity ETF with a total of 122 individual holdings. The top holdings are NVIDIA stock at 8.70%, Apple at 7.59%, Alphabet at 5.69%, Microsoft at 4.98%, and Amazon.com at 4.14%.
